description: This file defines functions for managing memory runtime plugins, including ensuring runtime initialization, obtaining memory search manager instances, resolving backend configuration, and closing search managers. It interacts with runtime plugin registry, configuration auto-enabling, and memory state modules.

methods.name: function ensureMemoryRuntime(cfg?: OpenClawConfig) { ensureMemoryRuntime
methods.description: Initializes and returns the current memory runtime, optionally auto-enabling plugins based on configuration.

methods.name: export async function getActiveMemorySearchManager(params: { getActiveMemorySearchManager
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a memory search manager for the given configuration and agent, returning an error message if the runtime is unavailable.

methods.name: export function resolveActiveMemoryBackendConfig(params: { cfg: OpenClawConfig; agentId: string / resolveActiveMemoryBackendConfig
methods.description: Resolves and returns the active memory backend configuration for the specified agent, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: export async function closeActiveMemorySearchManagers(cfg?: OpenClawConfig): Promise<void> { closeActiveMemorySearchManagers
methods.description: Closes all active memory search managers associated with the provided configuration.
